description: The Aerospace Information Research Institute classifies Guilin’s urban wetlands at two-metre resolution using GF-1 and GF-6 imagery from 2023. Eight classes distinguish woody and herbaceous wetlands, rivers, lakes, inland beaches, reservoirs or ponds, aquaculture ponds and canals or channels. ScienceDB identifies the collection with CC BY 4.0 rights for free reuse, although the top-level record does not specify the delivered file format. The map can define water and vegetation surfaces in urban drainage and green-infrastructure simulations. The reported overall classification accuracy does not guarantee correct labels at every location, and mapped wetland extent does not directly measure storage or conveyance capacity. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: 2m resolution fine classification dataset of urban wetlands in Guilin City in 2023
